 The giallorossi squad for Roma v Sassuolo
 November 07, 2026 
 Copy 
 Gian Piero Gasperini has issued the list of players called up for Roma v Sassuolo, day number 11 of Serie A. 
 Here are the players available to the coach.
 Goalkeepers:  Vasquez, De Marzi, Kilvinger
 Defenders:  Koulierakis, Ndicka, Molina, Hermoso, Balerdi, Wesley, Lulli, Ghilardi
 Midfielders:  Cristante, De Roon, Kone, Pisilli, Mora 
 Forwards:  Castro, Malen, Soulé, Maccaroni, Arena
